subject: Opportunity summary: prioritized pain points, proposed POC scope & timeline
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Opportunity summary: prioritized pain points, proposed POC scope & timeline

Hi Elena / Daniel —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial. I captured the items we discussed and a lightweight POC proposal below. Please flag anything I missed or that needs reprioritizing.

Key pain points you called out (prioritized)
- Latency spikes on multi-user inference during end-of-day batch exports (primary blocker for internal adoption)
- High per-token cost for embeddings used in similarity search across large customer datasets
- Lack of observability into per-request cost and KV cache hit-rates (makes cost budgeting hard)

Top goals for a successful POC
1) Achieve median generation latency under 250ms at 95th percentile for typical interactive workloads (5–10 concurrent sessions)
2) Reduce embedding unit cost by at least 30% on your nightly syncs using batching + quantization recommendations
3) Install observability dashboards showing per-route token cost, latency SLOs, and cache hit-rate within the trial environment

Proposed POC scope (4 weeks) — what Redwood will deliver
- Week 0: Access & baseline (staging workspace access, baseline perf tests, SOC2 summary shared)
- Week 1–2: Performance tuning (batching, routing policies, cache warm-up) and run evals on your top 10 prompts
- Week 3: Cost optimization (quantization suggestions, model variant A/B) and rerun embedding syncs
- Week 4: Acceptance criteria validation and handoff docs

Success metrics we agreed to measure
- 95th percentile latency for interactive flows <= 250ms
- Embedding unit cost reduction >= 30% on nightly job
- Observability: token cost and latency dashboards live with sample traces

Ownership & next steps
- ClearPath: provide representative dataset + credentials for staging S3 (Elena / Daniel) — by EOD Friday 8/14
- Redwood: share a POC charter PDF and SOC2 summary; provision trial workspace and invite ClearPath users (Marcus / Priyom) — ETA Mon 8/16
- Scheduling: short technical kickoff (30m) next week with Marcus and Priyom — propose Tue 8/17 or Wed 8/18

Attachments: I will attach a draft POC charter and our SOC2 summary for your security review.

If that looks good, I’ll drop the charter into the shared Drive and we’ll lock a time for tech kickoff.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Elena Torres <elena@clearpath.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel@clearpath.ai>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opportunity summary: prioritized pain points, proposed POC scope & timeline

Thanks Hannah — this is very helpful and aligns with our internal notes. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) Dataset: we can share a 10k-record sample and S3 read-only creds by Friday. Full nightly export will be gated until Week 2, but the sample should be fine for baseline perf and embeddings tests.
2) Users: please invite me (elena@clearpath.ai) and Daniel (cc'd) to the trial workspace; we’ll add one ML engineer and one infra lead after the kickoff.
3) Security: can you send the SOC2 summary and a brief note on data retention/egress policy? Our security team will want to confirm no logs are retained beyond the trial unless explicitly enabled.

One ask on the latency goal: our interactive flows include a 2–3k token context for the export step; if you can note how you plan to measure the 95th percentile (payload size and concurrency assumptions), that will help us validate the acceptance criteria.

Happy to lock Tue 8/17 10:00am PT for the technical kickoff.

—Elena
Director of ML Engineering, ClearPath AI
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@clearpath.ai>, Daniel Cho <daniel@clearpath.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Opportunity summary: prioritized pain points, proposed POC scope & timeline

Elena — great, thanks for the confirmations. A few quick replies inline and I attached the draft POC charter and SOC2 summary to this thread.

- Dataset & timeline: sample 10k S3 creds by Friday is perfect; we’ll run baseline perf tests against that and then request a copy of the nightly export for Week 2 workload validation.
- Users: I’ll invite you and Daniel to the workspace today; we’ll create a placeholder role for an "ML Evaluator" and an "Infra Reviewer" so you can add your folks.
- Security/retention: see page 2 of the attached SOC2 summary for our logging/retention posture. Short answer: logs are retained for 30 days by default; we can disable retention for trial if required — Priyom, can you confirm the toggle and note any limitations?
- Latency measurement: we’ll measure 95th percentile on requests with the same input size distribution you described. For the initial acceptance test we’ll use a 2.5k token synthetic workload at 5 concurrent users to simulate peak interactive export. Detailed test plan is on page 3 of the charter.

Action items before the kickoff (Tue 8/17 10:00am PT)
- ClearPath: sample dataset + S3 creds (Elena) — due Fri 8/14
- Redwood: invite users to workspace and send calendar invite (Hannah) — today
- Redwood Ops: provision trial workspace and pre-stage a test model variant (Marcus/Priyom) — target Mon 8/16

Attachments:
- redwood-poc-charter-v1.pdf (draft: scope, week-by-week plan, eval prompts)
- soc2-summary-2025.pdf (summary for security review)

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Hannah
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@clearpath.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Opportunity summary: prioritized pain points, proposed POC scope & timeline

Forwarding the thread — I’ll take point on provisioning and the retention toggle. Plan below and I’ve included the minimal checklist for onboarding ClearPath into our staging environment.

Provisioning plan (owner: Priyom)
- Create trial workspace for ClearPath (team: clearpath-ai) — add Elena and Daniel as users today.
- Pre-stage model: gpt-qa-v1-8k-quant (low-cost variant) and baseline model gpt-qa-v1-16k for perf A/B.
- Enable KV cache with 24-hour retention default but set retention toggle off for trial if they request (SOC2 concern).
- Generate baseline perf report using the 10k sample once creds arrive; baseline report due Mon 8/16 EOD.

Access and security checklist
- Confirm S3 read-only credentials and whitelist Redwood staging IPs (Elena)
- Share SOC2 summary with ClearPath security (attached)
- Create temporary service account for nightly embedding job (scoped to read-only S3)

Attachments: attached SOC2 summary and internal runbook excerpt (runbook: redwood-onboard-staging.md stub).

Marcus / Hannah — I’ll update HubSpot (HS-48291) with provisioning status and leave notes for the kickoff.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
